input.sql:
select 'mart' k, sum(first_offers) a,sum(dtfo_sum) b,sum(showings_sum) c from main.mart_segment_week where market='M02' and week between 52 and 55
union all select 'fo', count(*), sum(days_to_first_offer), sum(showings) from raw.homes where market='M02' and first_buyer_offer_date is not null and floor(date_diff('day', date '2025-01-06', first_buyer_offer_date)/7) between 52 and 55
union all select 'list', count(*), sum(days_to_first_offer), sum(showings) from raw.homes where market='M02' and first_buyer_offer_date is not null and floor(date_diff('day', date '2025-01-06', list_date)/7) between 52 and 55
